name: Develop complete functional software applications
description: Users asked the assistant to design and code complete, multi-component software applications, ranging from full-stack web platforms and mobile apps to specialized desktop tools. The requests frequently involved constructing core business logic, such as user authentication, database management, API integration, and real-time communication, using a diverse array of technologies and frameworks.
